title: Safe Quantum Stochastic Linear Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2611.29904v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We initiate the study of safe quantum stochastic linear bandits, in which a learner maximizes an unknown linear reward while satisfying unknown linear mean constraints at every interaction. Under coherent unitary access to the joint reward-and-constraint distribution, we develop QRS-COLTS, a staged quantum resampled-scaling analog of constrained linear Thompson sampling (COLTS). With high probability, QRS-COLTS plays only feasible actions and achieves regret that is polylogarithmic in the query horizon and scales only with the square root of the number of constraints. We also study a model in which the learner queries superpositions of actions while an unsafe-action flag, a "bomb" that terminates the interaction upon violation, is measured after every query. translated_title: 安全量子随机线性老虎机
translated_abstract: 我们开创了对安全量子随机线性老虎机问题的研究，其中学习器在最大化未知线性奖励的同时，需在每次交互中满足未知的线性均值约束。在具备对奖励与约束联合分布的相干酉访问条件下，我们开发了QRS-COLTS，这是约束线性汤姆森采样（COLTS）的分阶段量子重采样缩放版本。以高概率，QRS-COLTS仅执行可行动作，并实现关于查询范围呈多对数级的遗憾，且该遗憾仅随约束数量的平方根增长。我们还研究了另一种模型，其中学习器查询动作的叠加态，同时每次查询后测量一个不安全动作标志——即一个在违反约束时终止交互的“炸弹”。在此设定下，炸弹提供了对安全集的精确成员访问，且查询遗憾在动作叠加态上评估。针对此模型，我们提出了BCO-QLinTS算法（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文开创性地研究了安全量子随机线性老虎机问题，提出QRS-COLTS与BCO-QLinTS两种量子算法，在满足未知线性约束的前提下实现仅多对数级的遗憾，并首次探讨了含“炸弹”机制的量子叠加动作查询模型。
en_tdlr: This paper initiates the study of safe quantum stochastic linear bandits and proposes two quantum algorithms, QRS-COLTS and BCO-QLinTS, which achieve polylogarithmic regret while ensuring feasibility and safety under unknown linear constraints, including a novel model featuring a "bomb" mechanism for superposed action queries.
